::: {#def-sample-median}
#### Sample median

The **sample median** is the middle value
when the observations are sorted in increasing order.
In terms of the [order statistics](nonparametric-models.qmd#def-order-statistics)
$x_{(1)} \le \cdots \le x_{(n)}$:

- if $n$ is odd, the median is $x_{((n+1)/2)}$;
- if $n$ is even, the median is $\frac{1}{2}\paren{x_{(n/2)} + x_{(n/2 + 1)}}$.

:::
